notes: Layers are assigned by depth = distance (in cells) from the nearest outer face, expressed as a fraction of the half-size so any cube size works. Deeper = harder + more valuable. A tool whose tier is below the layer tier deals reduced damage (tierPenalty ^ difference). In co-op every voxel's HP is multiplied by players^coopHpExponent (keeps matches long without a bigger mesh) and value by players^coopValueExponent so each player still progresses through the shop.
